summary: Aging Fly Cell Atlas (Lu et al. 2023, Science), rebuilt from GEO GSE218661 and the authors' own head and body AnnData analyses, replacing the old FlyBase/SCEA load FBlc0006422 with fresh VFBseq ids. Single-nucleus 10x data from whole head and body, male and female, at 30, 50 and 70 days (72 new Samples/Assays), co-analysed by the authors with the Fly Cell Atlas 5-day head and body samples, which are reused from li_2022_fca_10x. Two Clusterings (head, body) with one Cluster per author cell type over all ages: 164 author types, 143 mapped to FBbt and loaded, 21 held. Summary expression for the loaded Clusters as CPM (15,989 genes x 566,254 cells; 133,771 cluster x gene rows with extent > 0.2).

decisions.decision: Map to cell-level FBbt terms only (a tissue or organ author term maps to its cell-level equivalent, else the type is held), and never narrow a generic type by the dissected tissue. Applied here through the FCA mappings.
Clusters with no FBbt term are held: listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason but not loaded (no VFBseq id, entity or expression rows). Their cells still count towards the Dataset's gene counts.
Summary expression is computed as CPM for every dataset, including ones whose authors ship normalised values (converted back to CPM).

Replace the old FlyBase/SCEA load FBlc0006422 (scRNAseq_2023_AFCA: per-age re-analyses D30 FBlc0006423, D50 FBlc0006887, D70 FBlc0007347, each with female and male sub-datasets) with fresh VFBseq ids; its FBbt assignments are used only as a mapping cross-check. Licence CC-BY-4.0.
One Clustering per author analysis (head, body), and one Cluster per author afca_annotation type over all ages (not split by age; age stays on the Samples).

General rule: reuse truly identical entities from another study by their VFBseq ids, and curate the source study first. The AFCA's 5-day cells are FCA 10x head and body cells (same barcodes and libraries), so the 26 FCA head/body Samples (FCA1, FCA4-15; FCA2, FCA16-27) and their Assays are reused from li_2022_fca_10x and linked from the AFCA Clusterings, not re-minted.

Samples from GEO: each GSM is one sample with one 10x library (paper: 6 female and 6 male samples per age, heads and bodies processed separately). Stage FBdv day 30 / 50 / 70 of adulthood; tissue adult head / adult postcephalic region (as for the FCA); sex from GEO. Flies are F1 of female W1118 x male Oregon R; the paper gives no stock numbers, so no stock is linked.
Held entries: the 'unannotated' cells of each analysis (hold reason leftover) and the numbered head types 'neuron 1' to 'neuron 17' (untyped).

The AFCA labels were transferred from the FCA's annotations, so each AFCA type takes the FCA's curator-reviewed type-level mapping: 133 by the same name, 10 '_head'/'_body' types by alias to the FCA type of that name. These mappings carry the FCA review date (2026-10-14).

Accepted the mappings of the two types the FCA lacks: 'cyst cell' to cyst cell of testis (broad; a grouped call over the FCA testis cyst-cell stages) and 'seminal vesicle & testis epithelia' to adult epithelial cell (broad; FBbt has no cell-level seminal vesicle epithelium term).

Expression from the authors' X (log(counts per 10,000 + 1), all genes) converted to CPM; level is the mean CPM over expressing cells, extent the fraction of expressing cells, rows kept with extent > 0.2. A reused FCA 5-day cell counts towards its AFCA cluster, as the authors grouped it. Genes are keyed by symbol: the FBgn from the FCA 10x files for the same symbol, else looked up in FlyBase Chado (FB2026_03); 1 split id dropped, 2 merges.

Narrow by dissected tissue only where the tissue makes the term exact: head 'adult fat body_head' -> adult pericerebral fat cell and body 'cell body glial cell' -> adult VNC cell body glial cell; recorded as cluster-level curator edits. Reviewed 2026-10-16. Clusters that could only be typed as 'neuron' ('neuron 1'-'neuron 17', Poxn neuron) stay held.
Revisit the fat mappings when FBbt issue #2218 (review adult fat terms) is fixed and released; tracked in checks/pending_fbbt_requests.json.

checks.check: verify_mappings.py: every FBbt term in the mappings looked up in OLS (FBbt 2026-10-01).
checks.result: 130 terms current, not obsolete, labels match.

checks.check: FBbt, FBdv and FBcv terms on the Samples, Assays and Dataset looked up in OLS.
checks.result: All 9 terms current (day 70 of adulthood is FBdv:0010010).

checks.check: Cross-check against the old load FBlc0006422: FBbt terms of its per-age files compared with the terms used here.
checks.result: 93 of its 100 terms are used here; the other 7 differ in granularity or are older terms.

checks.check: 5-day cells: the FCA head/body annotation of each AFCA type's 5-day cells compared by FBbt term (fca_5d_conflicts.py).
checks.result: 16 types where the FCA gave at least 20% of the cells a different, non-broader term, listed in fca_5d_conflicts.tsv for information (the AFCA label is the authors' typing and is mapped as given).

checks.check: Expression: the CPM conversion (every cell must sum to 1e6) and marker spot checks.
checks.result: Conversion check passed. Rh3/Rh4 in R7, SP in male accessory gland main cells, apolpp in fat body; indirect flight muscle led by bt, sls, Zasp52 and up (Act88F below the cutoff, as in the FCA). Per-cluster gene counts close to the FCA's for the same types.
